short_description: Bipolar-specific mood tracker for tracking mood episodes, sleep, medications, and generating reports for your doctor.
long_description: eMoods is designed specifically for people with bipolar disorder and their treatment providers. Unlike general mood trackers, eMoods tracks the specific dimensions important for bipolar: depression level, elevated mood, irritability, anxiety, sleep hours, and medications. The app generates PDF reports you can share with your psychiatrist or therapist, making it easier to spot patterns, adjust medications, and identify early warning signs of mood episodes.
patient_summary: eMoods helps you and your doctor understand your bipolar mood patterns. Track how you're feeling each day, see patterns over time, and bring reports to your appointments. It's like a detailed mood diary designed specifically for bipolar disorder.

pricing.notes: Free version includes core tracking. Premium adds unlimited history, PDF reports, and cloud sync.

privacy.notes: Data can be stored locally or with optional cloud sync. Export your data anytime.

faqs.q: Is eMoods specifically for bipolar disorder?
faqs.a: Yes. Unlike general mood trackers, eMoods is designed specifically for bipolar disorder. It tracks both depression and elevated mood (mania/hypomania), along with irritability, anxiety, sleep, and medications - all the dimensions important for managing bipolar.

faqs.q: Can I share eMoods data with my psychiatrist?
faqs.a: Yes. eMoods generates PDF reports showing your mood patterns, sleep, and medication adherence over time. Many users bring these reports to psychiatry appointments to help with medication adjustments and treatment planning.

faqs.q: How often should I track my mood in eMoods?
faqs.a: Most users track once daily, typically at the end of the day. Consistent daily tracking gives the most useful data. The app sends reminders to help you build the habit.

No. eMoods is a tracking tool that supports your treatment, not a replacement for it. Bipolar disorder requires professional treatment including medication and often therapy. eMoods helps you and your providers make better treatment decisions.
